diet_points.statement_en: Avoid alfalfa sprouts, seeds and tablets: they contain L-canavanine, which was linked to a lupus-like syndrome in primate feeding studies and in rare human case reports; the Johns Hopkins Lupus Center advises avoiding them completely.
